num_ships: <int> Total number of ships arriving at the dam.
num_berths: <int> Total number of berths available at the quay.
num_chambers: <int> Number of parallel lock chambers at the dam.
chamber_width_W: <float> Width of the lock chamber in meters.
chamber_length_L: <float> Length of the lock chamber in meters.
lockage_duration_Du: <float> Fixed duration in minutes required to complete one lockage operation.
min_time_between_lockages_MT: <float> Minimum time in minutes that must elapse between the completion of consecutive lockages.
lock_start_availability_sc: <float> Earliest time in minutes at which the lock chamber becomes available for use.
berth_end_availability_ek: <float> Latest time in minutes at which all berths cease to be available for service.
C_max: <int> Upper bound on the completion time used as a large constant in scheduling constraints.

ships.width: <float> Width of the ship in meters.
ships.length: <float> Length of the ship in meters.
ships.arrival_time: <float> Time in minutes at which the ship arrives at the coordination point.
ships.transshipment_penalty: <int> Extra cost incurred when the ship chooses to unload cargo at the quay instead of passing through the lock.
ships.mooring_set_MR: <list[int], length num_ships-1> Other ships to which this ship is allowed to moor inside the lock chamber.
ships.eligible_berths_B: <list[int], length num_berths> Berths at which this ship may be served if it chooses the transshipment mode.

berths.start_availability_sk: <float> Earliest time in minutes at which the berth becomes available for service.

handling_times: <list[list[int]], shape [num_ships][num_berths]> Time in minutes required to handle each ship's cargo at each berth.
